headword: {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}
gloss: gold, silver, and treasure; riches and valuables

definitions.gloss: gold, silver, and treasure; riches and valuables
definitions.explanation: A collective term for precious metals and treasures, evoking the image of a great hoard of wealth.

examples.japanese: {海賊|かいぞく}が{金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}を{隠|かく}した。
examples.english: The pirates hid their gold and treasure.

examples.japanese: {洞窟|どうくつ}の{奥|おく}には{金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}が{眠|ねむ}っているという{伝説|でんせつ}がある。
examples.english: Legend has it that gold and treasure lie sleeping deep within the cave.

examples.japanese: {戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}の{武将|ぶしょう}たちは{金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}を{集|あつ}め、{城|しろ}に{蓄|たくわ}えていたと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that the warlords of the Sengoku period collected gold, silver, and treasure and stored them in their castles.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字|よじ}{熟語|じゅくご}) combining {金銀|きんぎん} (gold and silver) + {財宝|ざいほう} (treasure; valuables). Evokes a literary or fairy-tale image of glittering riches. Commonly appears in stories about pirates, buried treasure, ancient kingdoms, and historical wealth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}を{集|あつ}める: to amass treasure
- {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}を{隠|かく}す: to hide treasure
- {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}が{眠|ねむ}る: treasure lies buried
- {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}に{目|め}がくらむ: to be blinded by treasure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {財宝|ざいほう}: treasure; valuables — the general term for valuable possessions
- {宝物|たからもの}: treasure; prized possession — can refer to sentimental value, not just monetary
- {富|とみ}: wealth; riches — abstract concept of being wealthy
